skill.summary: 提供邮储银行司库系统核心业务场景查询，返回业务流程、接口组合及对应ASCII流程图支持模糊关键词匹配。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Treasury Scenarios Skill (v1.0.0)
- Enables scenario-based queries for 10 core treasury business processes
- Provides detailed business flows, interface combinations, and ASCII flow diagrams
- Supports keyword and fuzzy matching for scenario lookup
- Lists available scenarios when no direct match is found
